title: Benchmarking Requirement-to-Architecture Generation with Hybrid Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2604.06683v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Software architecture serves as the blueprint of a software system, capturing high-level structural decisions that shape downstream implementation and system quality. Despite this central role, generating architecture designs from requirement documents remains underexplored, with limited task-specific benchmarks for generation or rigorous evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce R2ABench, a benchmark for requirements-to-architecture (R2A) reasoning. R2ABench contains 68 projects with human-validated references collected from both educational-style settings and GitHub repositories. Each project is packaged as a unified instance that provides a structured software requirements specification (SRS), a reference architecture view in PlantUML, and the corresponding source requirement artifacts. translated_title: 基于混合评估的需求到架构生成基准测试
translated_abstract: 软件架构作为软件系统的蓝图，承载着影响下游实现与系统质量的高层结构决策。尽管地位核心，从需求文档生成架构设计这一任务仍缺乏深入研究，缺少针对该任务的生成基准与严格的评估方法。为填补这一空白，我们提出了R2ABench，一个面向需求到架构（R2A）推理的基准测试。R2ABench包含68个项目，配有经人工验证的参考答案，数据来源涵盖教学场景和GitHub代码仓库。每个项目被打包为统一实例，提供结构化的软件需求规格说明书（SRS）、PlantUML格式的参考架构视图以及对应的源需求工件。为评估生成的架构视图，我们设计了一个分层混合评估框架，涵盖语法验证、结构图诊断……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了R2ABench——一个面向需求到架构（R2A）推理的基准测试，包含68个经人工验证的项目，并设计了涵盖语法验证与结构图诊断的分层混合评估框架，以严格评估自动生成的软件架构设计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces R2ABench, a benchmark for requirements-to-architecture (R2A) reasoning with 68 human-validated projects, along with a layered hybrid evaluation framework spanning syntax validation and structural graph diagnostics to rigorously assess generated architecture designs.
